notes.title: Update Patch Notes – SteamVR Launch Fix & More!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Warriors!
We’ve just released a new update with several important improvements and fixes — thank you for your feedback and support![/p][h3]🔧 [b]What's New in This Update:[/b][/h3][p]✅ [b]SteamVR Launch Issue Fixed[/b]
We’ve resolved the problem where the game wouldn’t launch properly through SteamVR. You can now jump into the action without issues![/p][p]✅ [b]Return to Menu Anytime[/b]
You can now return to the main menu at any time using the [b]radial menu[/b] – no need to restart the game manually. More control, more comfort![/p][p]✅ [b]Bot Death Animations[/b]
Bots now have proper [b]death animations[/b], making combat feel more immersive and satisfying.[/p]

notes.title: Its time to launch!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]🛠️ VR Launch Info – Use OpenXR (Do Not Launch with SteamVR)[/h2][p]Thank you for supporting our game on launch day! 🎉
Please read the following important information to ensure the best VR experience:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔹 Do [b]not[/b] launch the game using SteamVR![/h3][p]Launching the game through SteamVR may error. Instead, please use [b]OpenXR[/b] directly.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]✅ How to properly launch the game in VR:[/h3][p]If you’re using [b]Oculus/Meta with Link or Air Link[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p]Open the [b]Oculus app[/b] on your PC.[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Settings > General[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Set [b]OpenXR Runtime[/b] to [b]Oculus[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Then launch the game from Steam.[/p][/*][/olist][p]If you’re using [b]Virtual Desktop (Meta Quest)[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p]Open the [b]Virtual Desktop app[/b] on your Quest headset.[/p][/*][*][p]Go to [b]Streaming Settings[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll down to [b]OpenXR Runtime[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Set it to [b]VDXR[/b] (⚠️ not Automatic or SteamVR).[/p][/*][*][p]Then launch the game from Steam as usual.[/p][/*][/olist][quote][p]This setup ensures correct VR play[/p][/quote][hr][/hr][h3]⚠️ Known Issues (v1.0 – Early Access):[/h3][list][*][p]Minor bugs in [b]kill statistics tracking[/b] – a fix is in progress.[/p][/*][*][p]Launching through [b]SteamVR is not supported[/b] and may cause graphical issues.[/p][/*][*][p]This is an [b]Early Access[/b] release – some bugs may still appear, and we’re actively working to improve stability and performance.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📣 Help Us Improve![/h3][p]Please report bugs and share feedback on our [b]Discord server[/b] or in the Steam Discussions section.
Your feedback means a lot and helps shape the future of the game! 🙌[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p]

notes.title: Warriors – Early Access Launch on June 27th!
notes.notes:
[p]Are you ready for the battlefield? 
We’re excited to announce that [i]Warriors[/i] will launch in [b]Early Access on June 27th, 2025[/b]![/p][p]🔥 Jump into intense multiplayer battles inspired by [i]Call of Duty[/i] and [i]Counter-Strike[/i], and experience fast-paced, tactical combat built for VR.
 We’re developing [i]Warriors[/i] alongside our community, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback as we continue building the ultimate VR shooter.[/p][p]Early Access will include:[/p][list][*][p]⚔️ Fast-paced multiplayer with 8 game modes[/p][/*][*][p]🏠 A special 2 missions [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]This is just the beginning – with your support, we’ll be adding new game modes, weapons, missions, and optimizations regularly.[/p][p]Add [i]Warriors[/i] to your wishlist and get ready – [b]it’s time to gear up and fight![/b] 💥[/p][p]👉 [i]See you on the battlefield, Soldier![/i][/p]

notes.title: 📢 Big Announcement! Warriors is Getting a Story Campaign! 🎮🔥
notes.notes:
Hello Warriors!

Until now, we’ve been focusing mainly on multiplayer, but now it’s time to share something special… Warriors VR will also feature campaign! 🔥 We’ve brought in additional developers who have been working on it for some time!

This means that in addition to thrilling PvP battles, you’ll be able to dive into a dynamic, action-packed story filled with intense missions and unexpected twists.

💣 What can you expect?
✔️ An action-packed single-player campaign 🌍
✔️ Adrenaline-fueled missions – stealth, shootouts, environmental interactions, and explosions 🎯
✔️ Smart AI enemies – it won’t be easy! 🤖

And this is just the beginning! In the coming weeks, we’ll share more details, so let us know in the comments what you’re most excited for! 🔥

Add Warriors to your wishlist and stay tuned! 🛡️🎮
